fields.summary_ko.0: AAPL recently reached an all-time high and achieved double-digit revenue growth in only 4 of the past 16 years, but currently shows strong performance with normalized net margins exceeding 20%.
fields.summary_ko.1: AAPL maintains high valuation with P/E ratio of 40x and forward P/E of 38x, but the likelihood of stock decline under new CEO leadership is low, making it a buy recommendation.
